actual_scope: Prove the exact characteristic-three rank of I-A_h on nonempty proper Boolean subsets for every even h >= 4, retaining the known h=2 exception, and deduce the exact additive rank-one repair count.
scope_change_reason: Take the explicit open even-dimensional question in Nick Petalas PR5173 after its released handoff; this is a scoped algebraic interface proof rather than formal proof-assistant work or a repetition of the odd-dimensional inverse.
bottleneck_link: The disjointness endpoint of mikey1201 PR172 requires repair. This theorem completes its characteristic-three additive rank obstruction. It supplies no native ternary realization or recursive cost improvement; all physical costs remain outside scope.
stop_rule: One all-even-dimensional rank theorem with a proved endpoint-deletion step; a finite rank table alone would be insufficient. Stop after this result and its verification. Do not expand into other fields, nonadditive repairs or physical implementation. Budget includes publication.
evidence: PROOF.md proves rank = 3*2^(h-2)-1-(-1)^(h/2)*2^(h/2-1) for all even h>=4. RESULTS.json is regenerated by verify.py: ranks at h=2,4,6,8,10; separate dense ranks through h=8; 729 small rank-engine fixtures; 340 complete polynomial-identity columns; complete h=2/4 kernel counts; 100 integer multiplicity checks; thirteen rejection controls. Normal and optimized registered commands are declared.
